entities.summary: Easter Rising, War of Independence & Treaty, a transformative movement in Ireland (1914–1923). Emerged from Michael Collins and the Anglo-Irish Treaty and Parnell, Land War & Home Rule. Catalyzed Easter Rising — Proclamation of the Irish Republic and Anglo-Irish Treaty and partition of Ireland.
